audit: Fishing Spot Coordinate Lineage & Duplicate Verification V1

coordinateContract.sourceCrs: EPSG:5179 for the recovery path; official portal CRS metadata absent
coordinateContract.transformationMethod: Custom TypeScript inverse Transverse Mercator implementation
coordinateContract.transformationVersion: git commit f47cb23; semantic version UNKNOWN

lineage.documentationGap: The 426-row original DMS normalizer is absent; the recovery converter and apply chain are preserved.

reproducibility.toleranceBasis: Six-decimal WGS84 storage is sub-meter at Korean latitudes; 1 m allows rounding while remaining conservative.

allRowsAgainstEpsg5179.note: This comparison corroborates CRS identity but is not the asserted lineage path for the 426 DMS-derived rows.

duplicateGroups.reason: Distinct regions and places share the same official raw projected point.
Distinct regions and places share the same official raw projected point.
Distinct place names share one official raw projected point; the source does not explain whether it is representative.
Three distinct place names share one official raw projected point; representative-coordinate reuse cannot be distinguished from an error.
Distinct named areas share one official raw projected point; internal source fields do not resolve the conflict.
Both names refer to the Sangjokam excursion-boat area in the same city and share the source coordinate.

crossRegionGroups.reason: Distinct regions and places share the same official raw projected point.
Distinct regions and places share the same official raw projected point.

nearDuplicates.reason: Separate official projected points reproduce the approximately 80 m separation and names describe different landmarks.

navigation.safetyBoundary: Map/navigation eligibility only means a coordinate can be rendered. It does not assert a safe route, access permission, hazard avoidance, or depth clearance.

unresolvedIssues: The official portal metadata names the projected geometry field but does not declare its CRS.
The original DMS-to-decimal normalization script/version for 426 unchanged rows is not present.
No authoritative replacement coordinates are available for the four cross-region conflict rows.
Three same-region source-coordinate reuse groups need provider clarification or authoritative row-level correction evidence.
